exercises.name: Dumbbell Incline Bench Press
exercises.notes: HOLD 22.5kg, reps 12 -> 10. Last time the 22.5 jump broke you: 12 / 9 / 8 and you had to drop to 20kg on set 3, RPE 10. That is not a weight you own yet. Own it at 10 reps first - 3 clean sets of 10 at 22.5 and the 12s come back next cycle.

exercises.name: Box Squat
exercises.notes: UP to 52.5kg (from the 50 you actually used). 3x10 @ RPE 7 is the single cleanest set of data in your last two sessions and the only lift that earned a jump. You already did 52.5 @ RPE 8 on 07-03, so this is re-taking known ground. KNEE: high box, controlled depth, no bouncing off the box.

exercises.name: Cable Row
exercises.notes: HOLD 50kg, reps 12 -> 10. You completed 3x12 but at RPE 10 - completed and maxed is not the same as earned. An accessory pull should sit at RPE 7-8 on a cut. Shorter rest here is deliberate: it is one of the time savings that keeps today under an hour.

exercises.name: Bulgarian Split Squat
exercises.notes: HOLD 10kg x 10 per leg. Third session in a row at 3x10 @ RPE 8-9 - right zone, no change needed. KNEE: front shin vertical, weight through the front heel, stop short of full flexion on the back knee.

exercises.name: Lat Pulldown
exercises.notes: HOLD 40kg, reps 12 -> 10. Read the trend: 45kg x 12 @ RPE 9 on 07-03, then 40kg x 12 still @ RPE 10 on 07-26. You deloaded 5kg and it got HARDER - that is a recovery signal, not a lat problem. Stack steps in 5kg so 40 stays. TIME LEVER: if you are past 45 min when you reach this, do 2 sets instead of 3 - Cable Row already covered your back today.

exercises.name: Hammer Curl
exercises.notes: HOLD 12.5kg, reps 10 -> 12. Progressing by reps on purpose: 15kg is where your form broke down on 07-03, so earn 3x12 at 12.5 before going back. 3x10 @ RPE 8 last time means there is room.

exercises.name: Machine Preacher Curl (drop set)
exercises.notes: ONE triple-drop, no rest between drops: 35kg to failure -> 30kg -> 25kg. Start weight is UP from 30 because you actually ran 35 on 07-31 and got 9 reps out of it. RPE 10 here is by design. Go straight from the last Hammer Curl set into this with minimal transition - biceps are already warm and it saves you 2-3 min.

session_notes: UNDER-AN-HOUR BUILD. Same 7 exercises, but rest is tightened (Cable Row 75s, Lat Pulldown and Hammer Curl 60s) and Hammer Curl runs straight into the preacher drop set. Math: ~22 working sets at these rests plus a 5-min warmup lands around 52-55 min. Your last two sessions were 58 and 62 min, so the difference is rest discipline, not exercise count - watch the clock between sets, that is the whole trick. If you are behind at the 45-min mark, the named cut is Lat Pulldown set 3. PROGRESSION: only Box Squat (50 -> 52.5) and the preacher start (30 -> 35) go up. Everything else holds, and four rep targets come down 12 -> 10. That is intentional. THE PATTERN WORTH SEEING: across 07-26, 07-28 and 07-31 you logged RPE 9-10 on nearly every exercise, reps declining across sets, and you wrote 'very low energy' twice. On a cut that is fatigue accumulating faster than you are recovering, and RPE 10 training buys you no extra muscle retention over RPE 8-9 - it just costs recovery and raises injury risk. Today is built to land at RPE 8-9. If it still feels like a 10 on the holds, log that and the next call is a real deload week, not another rep trim.
